name: Serve Plain File
description: Serve plain files which can be configured in the backend.

suggests.drupal/config_ignore: Keep served-file config editable in production without being overwritten by config import.

project_description: Serve Plain File provides a way to serve configurable plain-text files whose path and content are defined in the Drupal backend. The main idea is to configure static files such as ads.txt, sellers.json, Google site-verification, or a Facebook domain-ownership file directly in the admin UI, where they can be added or changed regularly (e.g. by SEOs) without editing the docroot or touching server configuration. Each served file is stored as a served_file config entity, so it can be imported/exported through Drupal's configuration workflow, or kept editable in production via Config Ignore. A dynamic route is registered for each configured path and the content is returned with the configured MIME-Type (restricted to an admin-defined allowlist) and cache max-age. Multi-language serving is supported only when domain-based language negotiation is enabled.
